sections.Effects: * Grants a repelling blue aura that strongly pushes projectiles and enemies away from Isaac for one minute.
sections.Strategy: * Since the effect lasts one minute, it is advised to use it on bosses that fire high amounts of projectiles such as {{e|Mega Satan}}, {{e|Hush}}, {{e|Delirium}}, or {{e|Mother}}.
sections.Notes:
* Once the minute has passed, Isaac reverts back to his normal state on the spot, he does not need to change rooms to remove the effect.
* '''I - The Magician?''''s effect is similar to the {{i|The Soul}}'s but stronger, with a wider area of effect, and has consistent effect strength.
* As long as Isaac does not walk into a projectile or enemy himself, most projectiles will be completely repelled and enemies cannot come into contact with Isaac.
** Certain enemies can bypass the effect if they dash fast enough, such as {{e|Oob}}s.
* Additional uses of '''I - The Magician?''' only refresh the one minute timer.
sections.Interactions: * {{I|Tarot Cloth}}: No effect.

sections.Effects: * Teleports Isaac into an extra {{r|Boss Room}} from the boss pool two floors deeper than the current floor (but never a final boss). The boss will drop a reward. Exiting the room returns Isaac to where he used the card.
sections.Notes:
* Using IV - The Emperor? in {{s|Womb}} / {{s|Utero}}/ {{s|Scarred Womb}} / {{s|Corpse}} I or II will teleport Isaac to a boss fight from the current boss pool.
** Using it in {{s|Sheol}} / {{s|Cathedral}} / {{s|Dark Room}} / {{s|Chest}} / {{s|The Void}} / {{s|Home}} will teleport Isaac to a random room.
** Using it in {{s|???}} will teleport Isaac to a boss fight from the {{S|Womb}} boss pool.
** Using it in an {{R|I AM ERROR}} room or a {{r|Black Market}} will take Isaac to the last room he was in when exited, allowing him to further explore the floor.
* Using IV - The Emperor? again on the same floor after defeating the boss it spawns takes Isaac back to the same cleared Boss room.
* If IV - The Emperor? is used in [[Chapter 3]] (i.e. {{s|Depths}}), the [[Chapter 4]] boss will only deal regular damage to Isaac, rather than the whole heart damage penalty of the chapter.
** This is one of the few situations where bosses such as {{e|It Lives!}} dealing a whole heart of projectile damage, or {{e|Daddy Long Legs}} dealing a whole heart of contact damage takes effect.
* {{r|Devil Room}}s / {{r|Angel Room}}s do not appear from the extra boss rooms.
* IV - The Emperor? cannot spawn in [[greed mode]].
sections.Strategy:
* IV - The Emperor? can be used to steal an item from {{r|Boss Rush}} without going through the waves. After taking the item, using the card and defeating the extra boss, leaving the room will lead Isaac to the regular, locked {{E|Mom}} boss room.{{dlc-}}
** {{r|Challenge Room}}s / {{r|Boss Challenge Room}}s can also be stolen from. Returning to the room after defeating the extra boss will make the room inactive (until another element is interacted with).
sections.Synergies:
* {{i|Blanket}}: A shield is granted upon teleporting to the extra boss room.
* {{t|Hairpin}}: The currently held active item is fully charged the first time the extra boss room is teleported to. The normal boss room also charges the active item.
* {{i|There's Options}}: The extra boss room's reward will be two choice pedestals.
* {{t|Tick}}: Heals 1 {{e|Red Heart}} upon teleporting to the extra boss room. The normal boss room also provides healing.
sections.Interactions:
* {{I|Tarot Cloth|n}}: No effect.
* {{i|Book of Revelations}}: Does not guarantee the extra boss to be a [[The Harbingers|harbinger]].
* {{i|Satanic Bible}}: The extra boss room's reward is also transformed into a devil deal.
* {{i|Sol}}: Defeating the extra boss will not activate Sol's effect.
* {{i|Vanishing Twin}}: The twin will clone the extra boss and spawn an item if the original one has not been visited yet. The vanishing twin familiar is consumed and will not allow for another item to be obtained from the floor's original boss, because the familiar won't respawn until the next floor.

* The effect does not stack with itself.
* The card's effect persists in the {{i|Knife Piece 2}} abandoned area.
* The temporary [[heart container]]s granted by III - The Empress? can be spent for purposes such as [[devil deal]]s and {{i|Potato Peeler}}, and doing so will not affect Isaac's permanent containers after the effect runs out.
sections.Synergies: * {{I|Tarot Cloth}}: Adds a total of three temporary [[heart container]]s.

sections.Effects: * For the current room, enemies are [[slow]]ed, Isaac's [[speed]] is increased by 0.50, and his [[shot speed]] is decreased by 1.00.
sections.Notes:
* Being a [[special card]], the '''Era Walk''' has a significantly lower chance of appearing compared to other cards.
* The card's effect does not stack if it is used multiple times in the same room.
* While the effect is active, Isaac will appear to have {{i|Stop Watch}}, although this is purely cosmetic.
* Does not slow down stomping Mom's feet spawned by {{i|Broken Shovel 1}}.
sections.Interactions: * {{i|Tarot Cloth}}: No effect.

sections.Effects: * Teleports Isaac to the {{r|Devil Room}} or {{r|Angel Room}}.
sections.Notes:
* Using the '''Joker''' in {{s|Womb}} II / {{s|Utero}} II / {{s|Scarred Womb}} II will teleport Isaac to the Devil Room or Angel Room with a trapdoor leading to {{s|Sheol}} or a light beam leading to the {{s|Cathedral}} (respectively). This can be used to skip {{e|Mom's Heart}} and will not count as a kill.
** {{dlc+|a}} After unlocking {{e|It Lives!}}, Devil or Angel Rooms in {{s|Womb}} / {{s|Utero}} / {{s|Scarred Womb}} II no longer contain trapdoors and instead have their normal contents.{{dlc-}}
* Using The Joker card can allow Isaac to encounter Devil Rooms or Angel Rooms on floors they otherwise cannot appear on, such as the first floor, or {{s|Corpse}} II.
* Unlike all teleportation cards, the '''Joker''' still works normally when {{curse|maze}} is active.
* {{dlc|nr}} The '''Joker''' cannot spawn in {{mode|greed}} [[Greed mode]].
* Using the '''Joker''' does not affect the spawn chance of Devil and Angel Rooms.
** {{dlc|r}} This includes the 100% chance of an Angel Room appearing after skipping the first Devil Room. If a '''Joker''' card is used to teleport to Angel Room and it has not spawned after defeating the boss, the 100% chance will get carried over to the next floor as usual.
sections.Strategy: * {{dlc+|r}} Touching the {{e|White Fire Place}} in {{s|Downpour}} II / {{s|Dross}} II temporarily turns Isaac into a ghost. Using the '''Joker''' allows Isaac to take the devil deals for free, which is normally impossible because beating the boss makes Isaac lose his ghost form before entering the devil room. {{dlc-}}
sections.Synergies: * {{i|Eucharist}}: Always teleports to an {{r|Angel Room}}.
sections.Interactions:
* {{I|Tarot Cloth}}: No effect.
* {{i|Duality}}: Teleportation ''before'' defeating the boss and choosing a door will follow the normal rules of Devil/Angel Room generation, instead of a 50/50 chance.
** This means that if Duality was taken as a Devil deal, or any other deal with the Devil was made in the run, teleportation will always lead to the {{R|Devil Room}}.
** The room that was chosen this way will be the only one that opens once the boss is defeated.
** Teleporting after choosing a door will always teleport to the same room.

sections.Effects:
* Upon activation, Isaac throws the card in front of himself.
** The card is thrown in the direction Isaac's '''''body''''' is facing, meaning the card will be thrown in the direction Isaac is moving. If he is stationary, it will be thrown in the last direction that Isaac moved.
* The thrown card kills ''anything'' in its path (including end-game [[boss]]es like {{E|???}} and otherwise indestructible entities like {{E|Stone Grimace}}s and {{E|Wall Hugger}}s) and gets stuck in the ground/wall after being thrown.
** The only exceptions to this are {{E|Delirium}}, {{E|The Beast}}, {{E|Mother's Shadow}} and {{E|Dark Esau}}.
* The card can open doors as if a {{E|Bomb}} had exploded them, although it cannot open any locked doors or open the big door in the starting room of {{s|Dark Room}} and {{s|Chest}}.
* The card can extinguish fires, break rocks, and open secret rooms.
sections.Synergies:
* {{i|Angelic Prism}}: If the Chaos Card passes through the prism, it will replicate the Chaos Card four times each in their respective colors.
* {{i|Blank Card}}: Allows for an easy run by allowing repeated use of the card.
** Items such as {{i|Habit}}, {{i|9 Volt}}, and {{i|Charged Baby}} give more opportunities to use the card since all these items decrease the charge time of Blank Card.
** {{i|The Battery}} allows Blank Card to be used twice in a room, allowing multi-phase bosses to be killed instantly.
sections.Interactions: * {{i|Tarot Cloth}}: No effect.

sections.Strategy: * Using the '''Soul of Apollyon''' near an enemy can be dangerous: an explosive locust may spawn on it and immediately explode, damaging Isaac.

sections.Notes:
* {{dlc|r}} Only one trapdoor to the Crawl Space can be made per floor by using '''Ehwaz''' on a floor element,  as all subsequent uses will guarantee a trapdoor to the next floor.

* In hostile rooms, a trapdoor leading to the next floor will always be open, whereas a trapdoor leading to a crawl space will be closed until the room is cleared.
** However, in rooms that become hostile ({{r|Challenge Room}}, {{r|Boss Rush}}), the trapdoor to a crawl space will remain open even when the room is hostile.
* Using '''Ehwaz''' whilst Isaac is over a rock will destroy it.
* This Rune's effect is identical to {{i|We Need To Go Deeper!}}. ''See the item page for further effect notes.''
sections.Strategy: * {{dlc|r}} '''Ehwaz''' can be used to steal the contents of a {{r|Challenge Room}} / {{r|Boss Rush}} without facing the imposed challenge: using '''Ehwaz''' on a floor element will always spawn an open crawl space and entering it will reset the previous room to a neutral state, that Isaac can leave.

sections.Effects:
* Doubles Isaac's {{e|Red Heart}}s.
* If Isaac only has empty Red Heart containers, he is healed for 1 Red Heart.
sections.Notes: * '''2 of Hearts''' doesn't add new Red Heart containers, just fills empty ones. Nor does it double any other types of health.
sections.Strategy: * '''2 of Hearts''' can be used to significantly increase the use of {{r|Sacrifice Room}}s / {{e|Blood Donation Machine}}s / {{e|Devil Beggar}}s and any other health-draining object. The more heart containers, the more free hearts can be obtained form one use of the card.
sections.Synergies:

* {{c|Tainted Bethany|r}}: Doubles her Blood Charges.
sections.Interactions:
* {{I|Tarot Cloth|r}}: No effect.
* {{a|It's the Key}}: Acquiring red hearts with '''2 of Hearts''' does not invalidate the achievement condition.
* {{e|Bone Heart}}: Bone hearts are also filled by doubling health.
* {{e|Rotten Heart}}: If only a rotten heart is the only heart filling the otherwise empty heart containers, heals one heart.
** If there are red hearts and rotten hearts, the rotten heart is counted as a full red heart for doubling.

sections.Notes:
* '''III - The Empress''' effect can be stacked with itself.
** The damage bonus is the number of uses squared, e.g. +1.5 × 4 × 4 damage for using the card via a {{i|Blank Card}}, with {{i|Tarot Cloth}} and {{i|Car Battery}} equipped.
sections.Strategy: * Since this effect only lasts for a room, it is preferably used against a boss.
sections.Synergies:
* {{I|Tarot Cloth}}: Doubles the speed increase and quadruples the damage increase.
* {{i|Whore of Babylon}}: The effect stacks with each other, as they are the same.

sections.Effects:
* Releases in this order:
** 8 poison farts over 2 seconds while [[Tainted_???#Non-Throwable|brown creep]] is released for 1 second.
** 7 {{i|Butt Bombs}} are then released at the same rate as the farts.
sections.Notes:
* The farts and creep are the same as those from {{c|Tainted ???}}'s arsenal.
** The initial fart deals 5 damage, poisons enemies and reflects projectiles. 
** The creep gives +1.5 [[Fire Rate]] and +1 [[Damage]] if stood on, and deals 1.5x damage per tick to enemies.
** The butt bombs are affected by any bomb modifying items, although their appearance remains unchanged.

sections.Effects:
* Deals 40 damage to all enemies in the room.
* Turns [[pickup]]s into [[Blue Fly|Blue Flies]] and [[Blue Spider|Spiders]].
* Absorbs items and turns them into random stat upgrades.
sections.Notes:
* '''Black Rune''''s effect is similar to {{i|Void|n}}.
** Unlike {{I|Void}}, the '''Black Rune''' will grant stat ups for sacrificing active items. This makes '''Black Rune''' useful even while holding Void, as any active item that would be detrimental to absorb can instead be absorbed by '''Black Rune'''.
** Like {{I|Void}}, stats gained by a '''Black Rune''' will be removed when Isaac's build is re-rolled (e.g. with {{I|D4}} or a {{R|Dice Room}}).
* Using a '''Black Rune''' to absorb items in {{r|Boss Rush}} or {{r|Boss Challenge Room}}s counts as taking the items and will cause waves of bosses or enemies to start spawning.
* If Black Runes have not been unlocked, they will be replaced by random Cards of any type, rather than {{p|Rune Shard}}s, in any room layouts containing them.
* {{dlc+|r}} If Isaac uses the '''Black Rune''' to absorb items from a room with choice pedestals, it will only absorb one item, and the other item vanishes.{{dlc-}}
sections.Strategy:
* {{dlc+|r}} If a '''Black Rune''' is used while Isaac is holding an item above his head, it will consume the item. This allows him to immediately absorb passive items bought from {{r|Devil Room}}s, {{r|Black Market}}s, or {{r|Shop}}s. This also can be used to give Isaac a chance to see what an unknown item is before deciding if he wants to consume it.{{dlc-}}
* {{dlc+|r}} The '''Black Rune''' can be used to absorb {{i|Knife Piece 1}} if {{e|Mother}} isn't the goal of the run. Can also be used to absorb {{i|Key Piece 1}} or {{i|Key Piece 2}}.{{dlc-}}
sections.Synergies:

* {{t|A Missing Page|r}} / {{i|Missing Page 2|r}}: Deals +40 damage per copy.
sections.Interactions:
* {{I|Tarot Cloth|r}}: No effect.
* {{i|Death Certificate}}: Only allows the consumption of one item. The consumed item is treated as if it was picked up causing all other items in the room to disappear and forcing Isaac to leave the area.
* {{t|Endless Nameless}}: The newly spawned '''Black rune''' will spawn before the effect goes through, transforming it instantly into blue flies.

sections.Effects:
* Drops all [[heart]]s, [[trinket]]s, and [[pickup]]s Isaac currently possesses on the ground near him, leaving Isaac at half a heart.
* Pickups will be dropped grouped in their highest possible value:
** Every 25 cents will first be dropped as the {{i|A Quarter}}, then {{e|Dime}}s for every remaining 10 cents, {{e|Nickel}}s for every 5 cents, {{e|Double Penny|text=Double Pennies}} for every 2 cents, then finally a {{e|Penny}} if Isaac has 1 remaining cent.
** If Isaac has exactly 99 bombs, they will be dropped as {{i|Pyro}}. If less than 99, then {{i|Boom!}} for every 10 bombs, {{e|Double Bomb}}s for every 2 bombs, then finally a {{e|Bomb}} if Isaac has 1 remaining.
** If Isaac has exactly 99 keys, they will be dropped as {{i|Skeleton Key}}. If less than 99, then {{e|Key Ring}}s for every 2 Keys, then finally a {{e|Key}} if Isaac has 1 remaining.
** Every 2 full red hearts will first be dropped as {{e|Double Heart}}s, then {{e|Red Heart}}s for every remaining red heart, then finally a {{e|Half Red Heart}} if Isaac has one red heart remaining.
** {{e|Soul Heart}}s, {{e|Half Soul Heart}}s, and {{e|Black Heart}}s will be dropped as usual. If half a Black Heart needs to be dropped, it will drop as a Half Soul Heart. If Isaac only has Soul Hearts, then he will be left at half a Soul Heart. However, if Isaac has only Black Hearts or a mix of Black and Soul Hearts, then he will always be left at half a Black Heart.
** {{e|Gold Heart}}s will be dropped as usual.
** {{e|Bone Heart}}s will also be dropped. If Isaac only has Bone Hearts, then he can go down to one empty Bone Heart.
** A single {{e|Rotten Heart}} will not be dropped, and always stay in the container as the last remaining heart. Any additional Rotten Hearts will be dropped as usual.
sections.Notes:
* The pickups Isaac drops are set and are not affected by replacement effects, i.e. {{t|Daemon's Tail}}.
* If the amount of pickups dropped exceeds the room's allowed space, then extra pickups will be stacked near Isaac's position when he used the item. The player can still move out of the way while using the card to avoid picking them up.
sections.Strategy:
* '''0 - The Fool?'''‘s effect is most useful in generating item pedestals, as long as Isaac has enough pickups to sacrifice. These item pedestals can be then re-rolled through sources such as {{i|The D6}} or {{e|Shop Restock Machine}}s to get better items, or consumed through {{p|Black Rune}} or {{i|Abyss}} for other benefits. 
* As '''0 - The Fool?''' can generate a lot of pickups for Isaac to collect, it can activate effects which require pickup collection. Re-picking up Isaac's dropped hearts can contribute to {{i|Candy Heart}}, {{i|Immaculate Conception}}, {{i|Alabaster Box}} etc., and his dropped coins can contribute to {{t|Counterfeit Penny}}, {{t|Blessed Penny}}, etc..
* '''0 - The Fool?''' also allows Isaac a method to give pickups to {{i|Bum Friend}}, {{i|Key Bum}}, {{i|Dark Bum}}, or {{i|Bumbo}}.
* '''0 - The Fool?''' allows Isaac to manipulate his health without needing to take damage. Its uses include lowering health to access a {{r|Boss Challenge Room}}, dropping {{e|Soul Heart}}s on the ground so as to spend less valuable {{e|Red Heart}}s in {{r|Sacrifice Room}}s, etc.
** Similarly, it can be used to regain health in scenarios where that health would otherwise be taken away, such as accepting a [[Devil_Room#Deals_with_the_Devil|devil deal]] or taking {{i|Dead Cat}}.
sections.Synergies:

sections.Interactions:

* {{i|Little Baggy}} / {{i|Starter Deck}} / {{i|Polydactyly}}: The second held consumable will also be dropped.
* {{t|Mother's Kiss}}: If Isaac uses '''0 - The Fool?''' while having only one [[heart container]], he will die since dropping the trinket will remove his last health. Similarly, using the card as one of the characters that can't have red health while holding this trinket will kill the player instantly, as it drops the trinket, removing the last half soul heart the character normally would remain with.

sections.Notes:
* The Rune shard is a placeholder for rune spawns on a save file that doesn't have all runes unlocked yet. Once 6 runes of any kind (including soul stones) are available, Rune Shards cease to spawn.
** Before Repentance, unlocking only one rune would make all runes the same one. This exploit that incentivized against completion was fixed with the rune shard.
* The Jera effect activated by Rune Shards is similar to {{i|D1}} - it can create a variant of the pickup rather than its exact copy.
* The Perthro effect from Rune Shards has a chance to reroll an item into {{i|The Poop}} (ignoring item pools).
* The Ehwaz effect can still create {{r|Crawl Space}} entrances if used on a floor element.
* The three most valuable rune effects from Blank Rune are {{p|Perthro}}, for a re-roll, {{p|Jera}} for copying one drop, or {{p|Ehwaz}} for a {{r|Crawl Space}} which has a high chance of containing a free item. Therefore, the best use of Blank Rune is in a room with an item, after dropping a Trinket, Rune or Card on the floor, while standing over a [[We Need To Go Deeper!|tile with a special graphic]].

* Despite it not being a card, the '''Cracked Key''' is considered a [[special card]], so it has a significantly lower chance of appearing compared to other cards.
* Cracked Key's main purpose is to allow unlocking Tainted characters in {{s|Home}} without having to rely on finding the Red Key.
** To create a Cracked Key (once unlocked), drop any [[trinket]] in a {{r|Boss Room}} or a {{r|Treasure Room}} on any floor before acquiring {{i|Dad's Note}}, including the floor Dad's Note is in. After starting the [[Ascent]] by collecting Dad's Note, the trinket left behind will have become a Cracked Key in the corresponding room.
*** While trinkets are fairly common, there is always a chance one doesn't appear naturally. This chance can be avoided by clearing three consecutive floors without taking damage, which is guaranteed to cause {{T|Perfection}} to spawn.
*** {{i|Mom's Box}} can be helpful for creating Cracked Keys, providing extra trinkets to leave in Boss rooms or Treasure rooms for later use.
* Cracked Keys can also spawn in the same condition as any [[Card]].
* This item cannot be mimicked by Wild Card, {{i|Blank Card}} or {{i|Clear Rune}}, and {{i|Tarot Cloth}} has no effect on it.
* Using the Cracked Key in {{s|Home}} having unlocked that character's tainted version or as a tainted character will spawn the item {{i|Inner Child}} in the closet where the Tainted character would normally be found, as long as Inner Child is unlocked, otherwise there will be a shopkeeper.
** {{dlc|r+}} In [[Online Co-Op]], each player will unlock the Tainted version of the character they are playing as, regardless of whether they are alive or not, and if they are alive, they will also see the correct character, else seeing the host's character. However, if the host is playing as a Tainted character, the room will not contain any Tainted characters even if other players have not found their respective Tainted character, and the character will not be unlocked for anyone.
* If found before the [[Ascent]], the Cracked Key can serve as a {{r|Secret Room}} finder, as secret room entrances do not have red door outlines.
* Cracked Key cannot appear in [[greed mode]].

sections.Effects:
* Isaac turns visually into {{c|Keeper}} for 30 seconds, with triple shot, -0.1 [[Speed]] and a [[tears]] multiplier of x0.51.
* Killing an enemy during the effect makes them drop a random {{e|Penny||coin}}.
sections.Notes:

* Only enemies killed specifically by Isaac drop coins, those killed by Isaac's [[familiar]]s, or environmental hazards such as {{e|Fire Place}}s do not.
* Unlike many other on-kill drop resources effects, the coin drops do not suffer from diminishing returns on repeatedly spawned enemies.
* Further uses of '''XII - The Hanged Man?''' are additive, each adding 30 seconds to the effect's length.
* The card's effect persists in the {{i|Knife Piece 2}} abandoned area.
sections.Strategy: * XII - The Hanged Man? is best used against enemies that spawn many weak enemies such as {{e|Eggy||Eggies}} or {{e|The Duke of Flies}}.

Familiars obtained this way contribute toward transformations such as {{tf|Conjoined}}. * Soul of Lilith takes its familiars from the {{ip|Baby Shop|text=Baby Shop pool}}; however, when Isaac's items are rerolled, those familiars are rerolled in the {{ip|Treasure Room|text=Treasure Room item pool}}. * With {{c|Tainted Lost}}, Soul of Lilith is one of the few ways to obtain non-[[Item Tags offensive|offensive]] items.

** If Soul of Lilith is used while Tainted Isaac has an empty slot, the granted familiar ''will'' take up an inventory slot and can be dropped in exchange for another item as normal.
* {{i|Void}} / {{i|Abyss}} / {{i|Starter Deck}} (or other ways of holding 2 consumables at once) + {{p|Black Rune}}: Items granted by Soul of Lilith can be destroyed for their respective bonuses right after using the soul stone while the pedestal pickup animation is playing.

sections.Effects:
* Isaac dies, and is immediately revived at half a Heart in the same room, with 1.5 second of invincibility time. 
** The soul stone is automatically used upon taking fatal damage, acting as an extra life.
sections.Notes: * Soul of Lazarus has the highest priority of all [[:Category:Revival items|revival items]].
sections.Strategy:
* Soul of Lazarus is very precious for {{c|Tainted Lost}} as revival items are very rare with him.
* Soul of Lazarus can be used to steal a devil deal. If the deal taken would kill Isaac, the soul stone will revive him on the spot.
* One extremely niche use involves being one hit away from death on red HP, and using the soul stone to kill Isaac in order to preserve his chance for a {{r|Devil Room}}.
* As a revival item, it can be used to make use of high-risk/guaranteed death items such as {{i|Damocles}} or {{p|Suicide King}}.
* Since Soul of Lazarus revives Isaac in the same room he died in, it is useful against bosses as reviving does not reset their health.
sections.Synergies: * {{i|Plan C}}: Soul of Lazarus allow to use Plan C safely on bosses that have a death animation longer than 3 seconds.
sections.Interactions: * {{i|Echo Chamber}}: Getting automatically revived by Soul of Lazarus does not add it to the queue, and directly using the soul stone will not allow for automatic revival in the future.

sections.Effects:

** The jawbone club works similar to {{c|The Forgotten}}'s bone club.
sections.Notes: * The rune's effect is nearly identical to {{i|Berserk!}}, with the exceptions that Isaac will not get any speed bonuses from killing enemies, nor can the duration of the effect be extended. ''See the item page for more detailed information on the effect and notes.''

sections.Strategy:
* Even if Isaac is short on HP to use the machines, they can still be blown up for more pickups.
** To save on bombs, it is recommended to use '''XIV - Temperance''' next to a [[tinted rock]] or a {{r|Secret Room}}'s entrance, so that they can both be blown up by the same bomb.
* Since the machine/beggar prioritizes taking away {{e|Red Heart}}s, they can be placed next to a {{r|Curse Room}} and entered just after giving health to the machine/beggar. This halves the cost of potential Soul/Black Hearts for entering the Curse Room.
sections.Synergies:
* {{I|Tarot Cloth}}: Spawns 2 machines.
** {{I|Tarot Cloth|nr}} + {{i|Blank Card}} + {{i|Car Battery|n}} : Spawns 4 machines.
** {{I|Tarot Cloth|r}} + {{i|Blank Card}}: Only spawns one machine when used with Blank Card.

sections.Effects:
* All enemies (including [[bosses]]) in the room are [[weakened]], becoming slightly slower, having slightly slowed projectile speed, and taking double damage from all sources for up to a minute or until the room is cleared. Afflicted enemies also have their damage reduced to half a heart.
* Causes a purple fog to cover the room; this effect is purely visual.
* The effect lasts up to one minute, or until the room is left.
sections.Notes:
* Enemies spawned in later on, after Isaac has already used the card, will also be afflicted with weakness as long as the effect is active.
* Enemies' decreased damage applies even in the {{s|Womb}} stages and beyond.
sections.Interactions:
* {{I|Tarot Cloth}}: No effect.
* [[Addicted!]]: Makes Isaac take a full heart of damage even when '''XI - Strength?''' is active.

sections.Effects:
* Opens all doors in the room.
* Creates a {{r|Red Room}} on all valid walls of the room. This is indicated by walls that have red door outlines on them.
sections.Strategy:
* '''Soul of Cain''' can serve as a {{r|Secret Room}} finder, as secret room entrances do not have red door outlines.
* Refer to the {{r|Ultra Secret Room}} page for the strategy to better find it.

sections.Effects:
* Spawns 14 {{I|Dead Bird}} familiars that fly in from off-screen and attack enemies.
** They last 10 seconds and will begin to leave after the limit, but will stay as long as an enemy is alive. They will disappear if Isaac leaves the room.
sections.Notes: * When a bird expires and begins to leave, it will only disappear once it flies to the edge of the screen. If another monster spawns or becomes vulnerable before the bird can fully fly away, it will return and continue attacking.
sections.Interactions: * {{i|BFFS!}}: Doubles the damage of the dead birds.

sections.Effects: * Invokes a random {{r|Dice Room}} effect.
sections.Notes: * There is no clear indication as to what effect is triggered.
sections.Synergies: * {{I|Tarot Cloth}}: Invokes an additional random {{r|Dice Room}} effect.

sections.Effects:
* Creates 7 clusters of random [[rocks]] and other obstacles. The pathways between exits can't be blocked.
** Every [[rocks|rock]] has a 3% chance to be a [[tinted rock]].
sections.Strategy: * It is recommended to use '''XVI - The Tower?''' in a large room, as the clusters will be larger, increasing the chance of spawning tinted rocks.
sections.Synergies: * {{I|Tarot Cloth}}: Spawns 14 rock clusters.

sections.Effects:
* Creates a random item pedestal from the current room's item pool.
* Turns one [[Health#Red_Heart_Containers|Red Heart Container]] or two {{e|Soul Heart}}s into a [[Health#Broken_Hearts|Broken Heart]].
sections.Notes:
* Can cause Isaac to die if he no longer has health after the conversion.
* For the purposes of tracking {{i|Heartbreak|n}}'s effect on {{c|The Lost}} / {{c|Tainted Lost}}, VI - The Lovers? doesn't add any hidden [[Broken Heart]]s to their healthbar, allowing them to use the card without penalty.
* While they're functionally very similar, using VI - The Lovers? does not count as a use of {{i|Magic Skin}}, thus not adding or increasing the chance for future items to be replaced with Magic Skin.
* For {{c|Keeper}} / {{c|Tainted Keeper}}, broken hearts will lower the maximum amount of coin hearts he can have. Therefore use of this card on them isn't recommended.
sections.Synergies: * {{I|Tarot Cloth}}: Removes 2 heart containers or 4 Soul Heart, then adds 2 broken hearts and spawns 2 items.

sections.Effects: * Rerolls all items in the room, but they cycle back to the original item after one second, repeating.
sections.Notes:
* The reroll has the same rules as {{i|The D6}}.
* If more uses are stacked, an additional item per use will be cycled through.
* Activation of a {{e|Shop Restock Machine}} will reset the number of items that will be cycled through.
sections.Strategy:
* It is best to use this in a room with multiple items in order to maximize the amount of items seen, allowing for the most potential choices.
** A smart idea is to use this in the {{r|Angel Room}}. This is because they often have multiple pedestals, including the one spawned by fighting the [[Angel]].
sections.Interactions: * {{c|Isaac}} + {{i|Birthright}} / {{c|Tainted Isaac}} / {{i|Glitched Crown}}: An additional item will be cycled through.

sections.Effects: * Spawns 2 - 4 {{e|Locked Chest}}s.
sections.Notes: * The spawned Locked Chests have a 0.833% chance to be replaced by {{e|Mega Chest}}s if they are unlocked.
sections.Synergies:
* {{I|Tarot Cloth}}: Spawns 4-14 {{E|Locked Chest}}s.
** {{I|Tarot Cloth}} + {{i|Blank Card}}: Only 2-7 chests spawn.
sections.Interactions: * {{t|The Left Hand}}: Turns all spawned chests into {{e|Red Chest}}s.

sections.Effects:
* Forces Isaac to eat several random [[pills]] (from the run's pill pool) in quick succession.
** Eaten pill types become identified.
sections.Notes:
* Changing rooms while the pills are eaten does not stop the forced feeding of pills.
* If unlocked, [[Horse Pills]] can rarely appear in the sequence of force fed pills.
sections.Synergies: * {{I|Tarot Cloth}}: Forces Isaac to eat 10 [[pills]].
sections.Interactions:
* {{i|Acid Baby}}: Each eaten pill triggers Acid Baby's poison effect, dealing 10 damage per pill + extra poison damage.
* {{t|Endless Nameless}}: Only '''XIV - Temperance?''' itself can be copied, not the pill it generates.
* {{i|Lil Spewer}}: Each eaten pill changes Lil Spewer effect.
* [[Vurp!]]: Clones the last pill used.

sections.Effects:
* Spawns a {{e|Slot Machine}} (75% chance) or {{e|Fortune Telling Machine}} (25% chance) near Isaac.
** {{dlc+|r+}} Also has a 1% chance to spawn a {{e|Crane Game|n}}.{{dlc-}}
sections.Strategy:
* Even if Isaac is short on coins to use the machines, they can still be blown up for more pickups.
** To save on bombs, it is recommended to use '''X - Wheel of Fortune''' next to a [[tinted rock]] or a {{r|Secret Room}}'s entrance, so that they can both be blown up by the same bomb.
sections.Synergies:
* {{I|Tarot Cloth}}: Spawns 2 machines.
** Each machine can be any of the two types.
** {{I|Tarot Cloth|nr}} + {{i|Blank Card}} + {{i|Car Battery|n}}: Spawns 4 machines.
** {{I|Tarot Cloth|r}} + {{i|Blank Card}}: Only spawns one machine when used with Blank Card.

sections.Effects: * Drops a random type of [[Heart]], {{e|Key}}, {{e|Bomb}}, and [[Coin]] pickup on the ground.
sections.Notes:
* The pickups spawned can be of any of their types (if unlocked):
** The coin can be of any value.
** The heart can be of any color.
** The key can be a {{e|Golden Key}}, a {{e|Charged Key}} {{dlc|nr}} but not a {{e|Key Ring}}.
** The bomb can be double, or even a {{e|Troll Bomb}}.
sections.Strategy:
* Some {{r|Super Secret Room}} layouts can force hearts in them to be of one type. Using '''VIII - Justice''' in these rooms can force the hearts to be of one specific type.
* Since the bomb can be a troll bomb, it's better to use '''VIII - Justice''' next to a [[tinted rock]] or a {{r|Secret Room}}'s entrance.
sections.Synergies:
* {{I|Tarot Cloth}}: Spawns two of each pickup.
** Each pickup can independently be of any type.
** {{I|Tarot Cloth|n}} + {{i|Blank Card}} + {{i|Car Battery|n}} : Spawns four of each pickup.

sections.Effects: * Spawns 2 {{e|Soul Heart}}s on the ground near Isaac.
sections.Notes:
* As the Soul Hearts are spawned on the ground, if the card is used too close to a pit or obstacle, or if there isn’t enough room around Isaac, the hearts can spawn on the other side of the pit or obstacle.
** Since the hearts need to be picked up and are not directly added to Isaac’s HP they will trigger effects such as {{i|Soul Locket}} or {{i|Immaculate Conception}}.
* Some {{r|Super Secret Room}} layouts can force hearts in them to be of one type. Using '''V - The Hierophant''' in these rooms can transform the soul hearts into other types of hearts, which may be an unwanted outcome.
sections.Synergies:
* {{I|Tarot Cloth|n}}: Spawns {{dlc|nr}} 4 / {{dlc|r}} 3 {{e|Soul Heart}}s.
** {{I|Tarot Cloth|n}} + {{i|Blank Card}} + {{i|Car Battery|n}} : Spawns {{dlc|nr}} 8 / {{dlc|r}} 6 soul hearts.

sections.Effects:
* Invokes {{i|The Bible}} effect.
* Grants [[Flight]] and spawns a {{i|Seraphim}} familiar for 30 seconds.
sections.Notes:
* {{i|The Bible}} effect can kill {{e|Mom}}, {{e|Mom's Heart}}, and {{e|It Lives!}}. It will also kill Isaac if '''XV - The Devil?''' is used during the {{e|Satan}} fight.
** As such, killing Mom with '''XV - The Devil?''' can also unlock {{a|A Halo}}.
* The card's effect persists in the {{i|Knife Piece 2}} abandoned area, allowing for easier completion of the chase sequence. However, the effect is likely to wear off before the end of the sequence.
* The Seraphim familiar disappears precisely 30 seconds after use, but the flight ability is removed only after exiting the room the 30 seconds were elapsed in.
sections.Interactions: * {{I|Tarot Cloth}}: No effect.

sections.Effects:
* Drops 1-25 random {{e|Penny|text=Coins}} on the ground.
** These coins may be any normal type with their respective usual chances: {{E|Penny|text=Pennies}}, {{E|Nickel}}s, {{E|Dime}}s, {{E|Lucky Penny|text=Lucky Pennies}}, {{E|Sticky Nickel}}s or {{E|Golden Penny|text=Golden Pennies}}.
** Denomination of coins that spawn is not affected by [[luck]].
sections.Interactions: * {{t|Nuh Uh!}}: Provides an abundance of resources from [[Chapter 4]] onward.

sections.Effects:
* Spawns {{c|Esau}} as a temporary secondary character, controlled at the same time as Isaac. He dies with no consequences if his health runs out, and disappears when Isaac leaves the room.
* Esau is given random items equal to the number of items Isaac has, each based on the pools of the items Isaac's were obtained from.
sections.Notes:
* The spawned Esau can interact with {{e|Blood Donation Machine}}s, {{e|Devil Beggar}}s, {{e|Hell Game}}s, and {{r|Sacrifice Room}} allowing {{C|The Lost}} and {{C|Tainted Lost}} to safely use them without dying, or a form of invulnerability.
* He cannot leave a room, so he can't be used to negate damage from exiting a {{r|Curse Room}}.
* He also cannot pick up items, nor can he pick up things such as pills/cards/soul stones.
** He can pick up all other pickups and can replenish his health by picking up hearts.
* When the '''Soul of Jacob and Esau''' is used, some items given to Esau will also apply to Isaac for the floor. This happens with {{i|Black Candle}} and mapping items such as {{i|The Compass}}, for example.
** If Esau is given {{i|PHD}} / {{i|False PHD|n}}, pills will remain identified for the rest of the run, even if negative pills aren't converted into positive ones.
** If Esau is given {{i|Eden's Blessing|n}}, an extra item will be given to Isaac at the start of the next run.

sections.Effects: * Spawns a {{e|Shop Restock Machine}} near Isaac.
sections.Strategy:
* It is recommended to check if Isaac has enough money before entering a {{r|Devil Room}} / {{r|Angel Room}} to reroll their items with this card.
** A bomb is all the more important in an angel room for obtaining and rerolling the key pieces.
sections.Synergies: * {{I|Tarot Cloth}}: Spawns 2 restock machines.

sections.Effects: * Kills Isaac and spawns 10 consumables and/or items around the location of use.
sections.Notes:
* Being a [[special card]], Suicide King has a significantly lower chance of appearing compared to other cards.
* The spawned collectibles will come from the [[Item Pool]] related to the Room where Suicide King was used (e.g. Angel Room items if used in an {{r|Angel Room}}).
sections.Strategy:
* Since using Suicide King means death, Isaac will need to have a resurrection item to make a good use of it, such as {{i|1up!}}, the {{i|Ankh}}, the {{i|Dead Cat}}, or being {{C|Lazarus}}.
** When combined with {{i|Blank Card}} and {{i|Dead Cat}}, the card can be used nine times (spawning a total of 90 consumables and/or items).
* Suicide King won't always drop a pedestal item, but often drops numerous Chests, meaning that using Suicide King on a [[special room]] or in {{s|Chest}}/{{s|Dark Room}} can be useful to get good items.
* {{dlc|r}} When doing a [[Repentance Co-Op|true co-op]] run, the player that uses Suicide King can be revived by beating the floor boss. An ideal time to use this card would be during the fight with the floor's boss while its health is low.
** {{dlc|r+}} In [[Online (open beta)|online co-op]] mode, the player who uses Suicide King can also be revived at any time, for a cost, using the {{e|Revive Machine}}.
* Although a niche situation, {{i|Echo Chamber}} and multiple Suicide Kings, likely via Echo Chambered {{p|Jera}}, and several extra lives like the Dead Cat allows stacking large amounts of rewards: each Suicide King in the Echo Chamber spawns its rewards, but Isaac dies only once, allowing up to 4x rewards per life. Counting remaining lives and using different consumables to remove the Suicide Kings from the Chamber afterwards is important to keep in mind.

sections.Effects: * Deals 40 damage to all enemies in the room.
sections.Notes:
* '''XIII - Death''''s effect is identical to {{i|The Necronomicon}}'s effect.
* {{dlc|a}} Damage from the card bypasses [[damage scaling]].
sections.Synergies:
* {{I|Tarot Cloth}}: Deals 80 damage.
** {{I|Tarot Cloth|r}} + {{i|Blank Card}}: Deals 40 damage.
* {{t|A Missing Page|r}} / {{i|Missing Page 2|r}}: Deals +40 damage per copy.

sections.Effects: * Spawns {{c|The Forgotten}} as a temporary secondary character, controlled at the same time as Isaac. He dies with no consequences if his health run out, and disappears when Isaac leaves the room. The bone swing deals high damage, and reflects tears.
sections.Notes:
* The spawned Forgotten can interact with {{e|Blood Donation Machine}}s, {{e|Devil Beggar}}s, {{e|Hell Game}}s, and {{r|Sacrifice Room}} allowing {{C|The Lost}} and {{C|Tainted Lost}} to safely use them without dying, or a form of invulnerability.
* He cannot leave a room, so he can't be used to negate damage from exiting a {{r|Curse Room}}.
* He also cannot pick up items, nor can he pick up things such as pills/cards/soul stones.
** He can pick up hearts, however he can only replenish his bone hearts by collecting a bone heart pickup.
* {{dlc|nr+}} If The Forgotten is hit, this will invalidate the conditions for spawning {{t|Perfection}}, regardless of whether or not the main character has been hit.
* The spawned Forgotten cannot switch to The Soul.
* {{E|Lucky Penny|text=Lucky Pennies}} picked up by the Forgotten will not give Isaac luck.
sections.Strategy: * As mentioned above, the Forgotten can be used to sacrifice health at various sources with no cost to Isaac, enabling Isaac to obtain certain items if lucky enough.

sections.Effects: * Grants [[flight]] for the duration of the room.
sections.Notes: * {{dlc+|r}} During the chase sequence following {{i|Knife Piece 2}}, XII - The Hanged Man may appear behind puzzle element and if reached, allows Isaac to skip an entire room by flying out of it.{{dlc-}}
sections.Strategy: * Flight can halve the cost of entering a {{r|Curse Room}}: entering a curse room while flying will not deal any damage. Exiting a curse room by its door will deal damage to Isaac in all cases.
sections.Interactions: * {{I|Tarot Cloth}}: No effect.

sections.Effects: * Grants the effects of {{i|Magic Mushroom}} (minus the health restoration) for one room. The added [[Red Heart container]] is not removed if doing so would kill Isaac.
sections.Strategy:
* Since this effect only lasts for a room, it is preferably used against a [[boss]].
* {{dlc|nr}} The heart container granted by '''XI - Strength''' cannot be used to purchase a [[devil deal]]. However, if Isaac has no other red heart containers to spend, then one granted by '''XI - Strength''' can be used this way. This also works if the devil deal costs 2 hearts, but Isaac only has 0 or 1 before activating the Strength card.
** {{dlc|r}} The heart container granted by the card can now be spent for any purposes (e. g. devil deals, {{i|Potato Peeler|n}}, etc.) without any restrictions.
sections.Synergies:
* {{I|Tarot Cloth}}: Doubles the stat increases, but the [[damage]] multiplier applies only once.
** {{I|Tarot Cloth|nr}} + {{i|Blank Card}} + {{i|Car Battery|n}} : Quadruples the stat increases.
** {{I|Tarot Cloth|r}} + {{i|Blank Card}} : Does not double stat increases if used with Blank card.

sections.Effects:
* Teleports Isaac to the {{r|Treasure Room}}.
* {{dlc+|r}} If there is a {{r|Planetarium}}, teleports Isaac there instead.{{dlc-}}
sections.Notes:
* {{dlc|nr}} XVII - The Stars cannot appear in [[greed mode]].
* Using XVII - The Stars on a floor that doesn't have a {{r|Treasure Room}} / {{r|Planetarium}} will teleport Isaac to a random room.
* When {{cu|Labyrinth}} is active, one of the two treasure rooms is chosen at random to teleport Isaac into.
** XVII - The Stars will always teleport to an unexplored treasure room. If one has been explored, it will teleport to the other.
* When {{curse|Maze}} is active, using this card can teleport Isaac to a random room instead.
sections.Strategy:
* XVII - The Stars allows to access the {{r|Treasure Room}} / {{r|Planetarium}} without using a key.
* XVII - The Stars can be used to escape any room that locks down after taking its contents, like {{r|Challenge Room}}s or {{r|Boss Rush}}, effectively "stealing" its contents without facing the imposed challenge.
sections.Synergies:
* {{I|Tarot Cloth|r}}: If the treasure room was unexplored before using XVII - The Stars, it will contain two choice item pedestals, as if {{i|More Options|n}} was active.
** It has no effect if it teleports to a planetarium.
sections.Interactions: * {{I|Tarot Cloth|nr}}: No effect.

sections.Effects:
* Spawns one of the following for each enemy already killed in the current room:
** An orbital bone familiar (very common).
** A [[friendly]] {{e|Bony}} (uncommon).
** A friendly {{e|Black Bony}} (rare).
** A friendly {{e|Bone Fly|n}} (uncommon).
** A friendly {{e|Revenant|n}} (rare).
** A friendly {{e|Big Bony}} (uncommon chance only if the killed enemy has high enough HP)
* {{dlc|rnr+}} Spawning an enemy other than a Bony/Black Bony is only possible after dying at least once to said enemy on the save file.
* The chance to spawn Revenants is greatly increased in {{s|Mausoleum}} / {{s|Gehenna}} / {{s|Sheol}} / {{s|Dark Room}}.
sections.Notes:
* '''XIII - Death?''''s effect is identical to that of {{i|Book of the Dead}}. ''Refer to its page to see in-depth interactions, detailed spawn chances, and notes about the bone orbitals.''
* Up to 32 enemy deaths can be tracked in the room. Those locations are used as spawn points for bone orbitals and Bonies.
** If Isaac leaves the room, the points are reset. Using '''XIII - Death?''' will have no effect.
sections.Strategy: * To gain the most value out of '''XIII - Death?''', it is recommended to leave enemies that can summon other enemies alive for longer, which will increase the number of dead enemies in one room.
sections.Interactions: * {{I|Tarot Cloth}}: No effect.

sections.Effects: * Turns Isaac into a ghost for the current room as if he touched the {{e|White Fire Place}} in {{s|Downpour}} II / {{s|Dross}} II, temporarily granting {{c|The Lost}}'s properties.
sections.Notes:
* '''Soul of The Lost''' does not actually turn the played character into {{c|The Lost}}. As such, completion marks will be attributed to the played character.
** However, it can be used to enter the Mirror Dimension in Downpour/Dross II. Isaac does not turn back into the original character after entering the mirror.
* Unlike touching the {{e|White Fire Place}}, the ghost form granted by the rune will always have {{i|Holy Mantle}} even if it hasn't been unlocked yet for {{c|The Lost}}. 
** The {{i|Holy Mantle}} shield gained from this can be stacked with multiple uses.
* The ghost form can take [[devil deal]]s at no HP cost, but can only take one.
sections.Strategy:
* Since in ghost form only one devil deal can be taken, it is better (if one has HP to spare) to pay for a devil deal then use '''Soul of the Lost''' on the most expensive item if applicable.
** Note that, unlike {{c|Tainted Jacob}}'s interaction with {{e|Dark Esau}}, using '''Soul of the Lost''' after taking a deal that would be fatal will '''not''' save you and will result in Isaac dying.
* '''Soul of The Lost''' can also be used as last resort in a boss fight to allow for one more hit before dying.
sections.Interactions:
* {{c|The Lost}}: Grants an additional holy mantle shield for the room.
* {{c|Tainted Lost}}: The shield granted by {{p|Holy Card}} is broken before the one granted by '''Soul of the Lost'''.

sections.Effects:
* Deals 100 damage to all enemies in the room.
* Reveals the map for the current floor, except for the {{r|Super Secret Room}} and {{r|Ultra Secret Room}}.
* Restores Isaac to full [[health]].
* {{dlc|r}} Removes {{cu|Darkness}} for the current floor.
sections.Notes: * {{dlc+|r+}} In [[multiplayer]], '''XIX - The Sun''' heals all players. Similarly, {{c|Jacob and Esau}} both receive healing regardless of who used the card, even in singleplayer.{{dlc-}}
sections.Strategy:
* '''XIX - The Sun''' is a powerful card thanks to its many effects.
** 100 damage is equivalent to a {{e|Bomb}}'s damage and will kill most enemies.
** The revealed map allows for optimized charge management.
** The full heal can help against tough boss fights, and also to make better use of {{e|Blood Donation Machine}}s, {{e|Devil Beggar}}s, {{r|Sacrifice Room}}s, etc.
sections.Synergies:
* {{I|Tarot Cloth|nr}}: Deals 200 damage to all enemies in the room.
* {{I|Tarot Cloth|r}}: Deals 400 damage.
** {{I|Tarot Cloth|r}} + {{i|Blank Card}}: Deals 200 damage when used with blank card.
sections.Interactions: * {{i|Book of Secrets|r}}: The mapping provided by '''XIX - The Sun''' does not count as a mapping effect. The amount of times the Book of Secrets must be used before activating the {{i|X-Ray Vision}} effect remains the same.

sections.Effects:
* Rerolls all [[pickups]], [[trinket]]s, and [[item]]s in the room.
** Rerolled items use random item pools, as if {{i|Chaos}} were held.
** Rerolled pickups and trinkets work identically to the {{i|D20}}.
sections.Notes:
* The reroll does not change a pedestal's item pool. Normally rerolling an item previously rerolled with the '''Soul of Eden''' will reset it to the current room's pool.
* {{dlc|r+}} The '''Soul of Eden''' can sometimes spawn within the special bedroom created by {{i|Lil Portal}}.
sections.Strategy: * It is better to use the '''Soul of Eden''' in a room with many items, as to maximize the number of rare items that can be obtained.
